about.title: About Us
about.desc: Operating since 2017. Trusted by more than 30 organisations for legal, compliant and rapid workforce deployment across the Kingdom.
about.heading: We supply uniformed, background-checked personnel to every sector of the Saudi economy.
about.p1: Basmat Al Mawared Company Limited is a licensed manpower supply company based in Riyadh. Since 2017 we have recruited, deployed and managed workforce for logistics, hospitality, cleaning, manufacturing and facilities clients across Saudi Arabia.
about.p2: Every placement is made on a Qiwa contract with WPS salary payment, GOSI registration and medical insurance. Transfers run through Muqeem. We handle Nitaqat alignment so your operation stays in the green tier.
about.p3: Clients keep one point of contact. We supply the people, the uniforms, the paperwork and a replacement if someone does not show. That is the whole offer.

cta.title: Need Workforce at Scale? Deploy in Days, Not Months
cta.desc: Warehouse crews, baristas, cleaners, machine operators and general helpers — uniformed, vetted and fully insured, delivered anywhere in the Kingdom with 100% MLSD compliance.

onfocus.title: Fully Compliant, Fully Transparent Workforce Management

q1.q: We ensure full compliance with Saudi labour law through Qiwa and Muqeem registration, WPS payroll administration, and adherence to Nitaqat standards. All workers are properly documented and insured.

q2.q: Applicants need a transferable Iqama or eligible for sponsorship transfer, a valid passport or national ID, and relevant educational or professional certificates. Specific requirements vary by role.

q3.q: The process typically takes 2-6 weeks depending on the role, documentation speed, and government processing times for Iqama and Qiwa registration.
